ncca0b4b6e6.headline: Venezuela reaches deal with UN to buy food, medicine with gold
ncca0b4b6e6.summary: Venezuela reached a deal with the UN Development Programme to use part of its gold held in Bank of England accounts to buy food and medicine during the pandemic, its central bank governor said.
ncca0b4b6e6.why: Venezuela's gold reserves held abroad are a key source of hard-currency funds, and their use affects the country's external finances.

ne582c4e852.headline: 'A director gone rogue': how Dudu Myeni 'wilfully' cost SAA billions
ne582c4e852.summary: A report says former SAA chairperson Dudu Myeni's actions and failure to conclude two crucial deals were reckless and wilful, not mere negligence. The report links her conduct to billions in losses at the airline.
ne582c4e852.why: South African Airways is a state-owned carrier, and governance failures at state enterprises affect public finances and investor confidence in state-linked companies.

n9f25757250.headline: Nissan Motor axes production capacity by a fifth after first loss in 11 years - BusinessToday
n9f25757250.summary: Nissan Motor plans to cut production capacity by a fifth after posting its first loss in 11 years. The Japanese carmaker's new four-year plan aims for steady growth rather than excessive expansion.
n9f25757250.why: Nissan is a major Japanese automaker, and changes to its capacity and strategy affect global car production and its suppliers.

n138e8fd1ba.headline: Here's what happens to your pay if you're told to self-isolate in test and trace

n138e8fd1ba.why: Statutory sick pay and income support for workers who must self-isolate affect labour supply and household spending, which feed into UK economic activity.

n8d3ced5287.headline: Fourth Iranian fuel tanker enters Venezuela, US slams 'distraction'
n8d3ced5287.summary: The Venezuelan navy said it escorted a fourth fuel tanker from Iran through its waters on Thursday. The United States called the shipments to the petrol-starved country a distraction.
n8d3ced5287.why: Venezuela holds some of the world's largest proven oil reserves, so fuel supply and sanctions-related shipments affect global crude and refined-product flows.

n54caac1267.headline: EIB to support development of 66 solar PV plants in Poland

n54caac1267.why: The European Investment Bank is the European Union's long-term lending arm, and its loans often finance renewable energy build-outs.
